summary.processing_visual_mapping: V1.2 owns three product visual states; IMAGE_RECOGNIZING EARLY/LATE are two keyframes of one product state, followed by FISH_LOCATED and SPECIES_RECOGNIZING.
summary.image_hash_method: SHA-256 recomputed over raw file bytes in the current source checkout; declared SHA is retained separately when source bytes are absent.
